headline: Full stack, and the pictures that go with it
bio: I build product interfaces and web apps with ColdFusion, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, Django, Python, SQL, PostgreSQL, React, Next.js, and shell. I edit in Lightroom, DaVinci Resolve, and Premiere Pro — reels, product shoots, and portraits. Bengaluru is home base. Builds can be remote. Shoots are on location.

homeBaseBody: Shoots on location in and around Bengaluru. Full-stack work can be remote. The map image is a texture, not a studio address.
